The outlaws of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} hid a very powerful sword and protected it with traps and puzzles. You collect four keys, take a barrel through the caves to stop a moving wall, use a {item:Power Ring} on a switch and make your way to the chest with the {item:Bright Sword} and a {item:Red Gem}.
The outlaws have hidden a very strong sword and protected it with traps and puzzles.
Outlaw Camp, next to the minotaur tower
Level 45 to pass the {item:Gate of Expertise} (50+ recommended).
1 is mandatory; the 2nd lets you repeat the switch on the same day. There may be one in a crate in the Wild Warriors cave
the normal barrel; there is one at the door of {npc:Rottin Wood}'s house in the Outlaw Camp
or the spell {spell:Levitate}; there are 3 daily boxes in a dead tree to the south
Recommended: {item:Stealth Ring} or the spell {spell:Invisible} for the orc room
Bring a friend: they can stay next to the hole where you pull the barrel to pull you up with the rope and avoid crossing the {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} again.

The last switch can only be used **once per day**. If the barrel is in the wrong place (or is the wrong type), you have to wait until the next day and get another Power Ring — unless you have 2 Power Rings (see notes).

The {wiki:Outlaw Camp} is on the surface, between **Thais** and **Venore**, **west** of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}. From Thais head **east**; from Venore, **west**/south-west. The minotaur tower, where the quest starts, is in the camp, **south** of the houses.
The three keys in the dead trees
First collect the keys for all the doors. The first three are inside dead trees, at ground level of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp}. Use each tree to pick up the key.
Dead tree right next to the minotaur tower, with a corpse beside it ({coord:32617,32251,7}).
Dead tree just **north** of the minotaur tower ({coord:32612,32243,7}).
Dead tree in a camp **south** of the main buildings of the Outlaw Camp ({coord:32651,32245,7}).
Map of the Outlaw Camp with the key trees
Next to the tree by the tower there is a pitfall: you can fall in by accident.

With the keys, enter the {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors} cave. The hole to dig with the {item:Shovel} is hidden behind a tree. Follow the path **north**: there are only Wild Warriors in this cave.
Entrance of the Wild Warriors cave (hole behind a tree)
Map of the Wild Warriors cave
If nobody has taken it, there is a {item:Power Ring} (and 3 containers of oil) in a crate in the room to the **south-east**.

At the end of the path there is a large room with four stairs going down. Go down the one in the **north-west** corner. There is a locked door with a switch behind it. Open the door with {item:Key 3303} and pull the switch: it moves a furnace in the room immediately to the south.

Go back up the stairs and go down the stairs to the **south**. There is a furnace with a {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} behind it. With the switch in the right position, you fit behind the furnace: open the chest and you receive the Golden {item:Key 3304}. To leave the cave, go up the stairs, go back **south** the same way to the entrance hole and climb up with the {item:Rope}.
The nearest barrel is at the door of {npc:Rottin Wood}'s house, in the Outlaw Camp. It has to be a normal {item:Barrel}.
If you buy the barrel in a furniture shop, you have to unwrap it, and you can only unwrap furniture in a house you have been invited to.
Take the barrel to the north cave
Drag the barrel to the Outlaw Camp and throw it down the hole (dig with the shovel) by the water, to the **north**. Go down as well.
Hole by the water, in the north
Put the barrel in the corner

In this cave there is only one path. Follow it to the end, where you cannot go any further. In this very small room, put the barrel in the **north-west** corner. Later you will pull it up with the rope through a hole. Then go back the same way to the hole by the water and climb up with the {item:Rope}.
Where to leave the barrel (north-west corner of the small room)
3. Go down past the Giant Spiders and use the Power Ring
Go back to the minotaur tower, to the **south**, and go up two floors. There is a sign that says *"Point of No Return"*. Walk off the roof: you fall down to the underground.
The tower roof with the "Point of No Return" sign
Follow the passage **west** and then **north**. You will meet two {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.
Map of the Giant Spider cave
The Giant Spiders poison and hit hard for this level.

At the **north** end of this cave there is a ledge. Use {spell:Levitate} or 3 {item:Parcel|parcels} (or equivalent) to go down one level. Below there are usually {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}.
The ledge where you have to levitate/use parcels
There are 3 boxes that appear daily in a {item:Dead Tree|dead tree} to the south, at ground level. Using {spell:Invisible} or a {item:Stealth Ring} makes this room easier.

There are two passages to the north. Take the one on the **left**: you find a wooden surface and a switch. Put the {item:Power Ring} on the wooden surface and pull the switch. The ring is teleported elsewhere (you will see it later, but you cannot get it back).
Map: the two passages to the north
The wooden surface and the switch
Now take the **right** passage, to the north. There is an {creature:Orc Shaman} and some {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}.
If this passage is closed, open it by putting a second Power Ring on the wooden surface and using the switch again.
4. Take the barrel to the wall
Pull the barrel up with the rope

You see a staircase going up and one going down. Take the **upper** one. Follow the short passage until you see an open hole: it is below this that you left the barrel. **Use** the {item:Rope} on the hole to pull the barrel up.
The hole where you pull the barrel up with the rope
Do NOT fall into this hole!

Drag the barrel back (towards the orc side) and to the left, and throw it down the stairs. In this room, to the south, there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and two {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}.
Kill the monsters first: the Ghouls and Skeletons summoned by the Bonelords can push and break the barrel.
Wedge the barrel in the wall

Drag the barrel **east** and pass the level 45 {item:Gate of Expertise}. Continue along the passage until a wall blocks the way. At the **south** part of that wall there is a small space where the barrel fits: put it there. It stops the wall from moving too far when you use the next switch.
Map to the wall where you wedge the barrel
The barrel wedged in the south part of the wall
5. Open the wall and the chest

Go back to where you pulled the barrel up and leave the cave by that passage. You can leave someone here to pull you up with the rope later; otherwise you will have to pass the {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} again.
Fall down the hole by the tree
Go back to the minotaur camp. Instead of going up, fall down the hole next to the dead tree (the same trap you may have fallen into when picking up the key).
Follow the passage **north**. There are two locked doors: the first opens with {item:Key 3301} and the second with {item:Key 3302}.
Map of the path through the two locked doors

You reach a staircase going up and another going down: **go down**. Continue to a room with {item:Fire Field|fire fields} on the floor and a mill with a switch. You should see your Power Ring behind a wall. Pull the switch: the ring turns into a fire field and another fire field appears next to the switch.
The mill room with the switch and the Power Ring behind the wall
This switch can only be used **once per day**.

Go back to where you wedged the barrel in the wall (after the level 45 Gate of Expertise): ask your friend to pull you up through the hole or cross the Giant Spiders again. If you did everything right, there is now a passage through the wall.

Go through the wall: there are 3 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and 2 {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}. Kill the Demon Skeletons, open the door with the Golden {item:Key 3304} and open the {item:Chest (Quest)|chest}. You receive a bag with the {item:Bright Sword} and a {item:Red Gem}.
The final room with the door and the chest
Leave the cave at the end

The wiki does not describe another exit from this room: go back through the wall and the {item:Gate of Expertise} to the hole where you pulled the barrel up and leave the cave by the same passage as in the step "Leave the cave". From there you return to the surface of the Outlaw Camp.

If the last switch has already been used that day (or you failed because of the barrel), there is a trick: bring an extra Power Ring and use **both** rings on the first switch (the wooden surface). Only after you use both can the second switch be used again on the same day.
